scientific_integrity: General claims proved analytically; exact computations are supporting finite checks, not infinite proofs. No independent audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: The unweighted Perrin counts, cycle maximal-independent-set identification and binomial summands are prior art; the assessed content is the minority wheel cut-quality landscape and its explicit Gaussian limit. Only fixed points, uniform simple wheels and synchronous tie-retaining minority updates are covered. Potential unindexed prior distributional results remain a priority risk.
title: Cut-size law for locally stable minority configurations on wheel graphs
